title: Way too big!
text: Way too big!. I should have read the dimensions better before ordering this. The good news is they had free shipping and free returns. It was incredibly user-friendly as far as it inflated quickly, but it was not all conducive to what I needed it for. It was also quite heavy and firm when I set it up to test it- I didn’t want to leave a bad review on a product I didn’t end up keeping. It may be great to keep in a second bedroom if you have extra storage space but there is nothing portable about this mattress.

product_metadata.title: iDOO Air Mattress with Built in Pump, Twin Size Inflatable Mattress, Fast Blow up Mattress for Home Camping Travel, colchon inflable, Airbed, Air Bed 18" Raised
features: It's never been so convenient- Inflation is fast! With the built-in pump, it only takes a few minutes to have a sturdy and durable air mattress. It's also easy to operate, just plug it in, flip the switch and it starts inflating immediately.

Ultra-durable: iDOO's multi-layer inflatable bed features extra-thick and waterproof material that resists punctures and damage. The top surface adds a flocked layer, making it super soft to the touch for added comfort.

Unique patented structure design: Straight beams and 18 internal air coils structure and enhance durability and support. The raised edge keeps your bed flat and stable, keeping your fitted sheets from slipping. Features a comfortable waterproof flocked top layer and puncture-resistant eco-friendly PVC. Enjoy Immediate Rest.

Easy to store and carry - travel storage bag included. The foldable inflatable bed can be stored in a small travel bag after deflation and will not take up space in your home or car. When you go out camping, We also have a manual valve that allows you to inflate using your own external air pump.

Best size: The standard queen size air mattress is perfect for accommodating a wide range of bedding in your home and can hold up to 650lbs. If you need another size, iDOO has twin, full, and king-size airbeds to meet your needs. Trust iDOO for all your inflatable bedding needs.
